notes: Model-specific diarization calibration record (ADR 0031) for the credential-free sherpa-onnx pipeline (D5): pyannote-segmentation-3.0 ONNX (segmentation) + 3D-Speaker CAM++ zh-en advanced (embedding) + FastClustering. model_identity binds both pinned asset SHA-256s, the sherpa-onnx backend and version, fp32 precision, the M1 CPU device class, and the rules fingerprint; a bound-identity change invalidates the qualification. The pipeline block records the exact execution configuration (agglomerative clustering with an unknown speaker count, 0.5 cosine threshold; 300 ms minimum speech-on and 500 ms minimum speech-off, sherpa-onnx defaults). thresholds.minimum_confidence gates formal SpeakerTurn publication: the sherpa pipeline emits hard post-clustering speaker assignments (a decided assignment carries confidence 1.0, not a soft probability), so the threshold reserves the gate for any future soft-scoring backend while keeping ADR 0030's meaning. qualification_scope is 'first_device_baseline': these settings qualify formal, anonymous, Part-local SpeakerTurns (uncalibrated diarization stays raw candidates per ADR 0031), but the zh+en speaker-separation quality of the selection is only confirmed by the maintainer sample review in the Phase 11 prototype ticket, not by this record.
